requests_requester_client_submission_key.tail:
(requester_id, client_submission_key)
         WHERE client_submission_key IS NOT NULL

ix_inventory_balance_lock.tail: (warehouse_id, stock_item_id, stock_status, batch_number, lot_number, serial_number, id)

ux_inventory_balance_identity.tail: (warehouse_id, stock_item_id, stock_status, batch_number, lot_number, serial_number, expiry_date) NULLS NOT DISTINCT

ux_available_serial_location.tail:
(stock_item_id, serial_number)
 WHERE serial_number IS NOT NULL AND stock_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND quantity > 0

supplier_invoice_identity_uq.tail: (supplier_id, normalized_invoice_number) WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL

one_actualization_per_voucher_uq.tail: (ap_voucher_id) WHERE stage='actual' AND ap_voucher_id IS NOT NULL

pending_item_requests_one_active_per_ite.tail: (requested_item_id) WHERE requested_item_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('submitted','review','needs_information')

procurement_case_activities_supplier_idx.tail: (supplier_id, activity_type) WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL

organization_units_institute_code_uq.tail: (institute_id, lower(code)) WHERE code IS NOT NULL

organization_positions_unique_authority_.tail:
(organization_unit_id, position_type)
  WHERE is_active AND position_type IN ('UNIT_HEAD','EXECUTIVE_HEAD','DEPARTMENT_HEAD','SECTION_HEAD')

asset_tags_active_epc_uq.tail: (institute_id,epc) WHERE epc IS NOT NULL AND tag_status='ACTIVE'

asset_tags_primary_uhf_uq.tail: (asset_id) WHERE is_primary AND tag_type='RFID_UHF' AND tag_status='ACTIVE'

rfid_read_asset_time_idx.tail: (asset_id,read_timestamp DESC) WHERE asset_id IS NOT NULL

rfid_read_portal_time_idx.tail: (portal_id,read_timestamp DESC) WHERE portal_id IS NOT NULL

custody_records_asset_idx.tail: (asset_id,created_at DESC) WHERE asset_id IS NOT NULL
